text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Lin, an American artist, was chosen by competition to design the Vietnam War memorial in Washington.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: She designed a long highly polished black marble wall, inscribed on which in columns are the names of all those who lost their lives in combat in the Vietnam War.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The wall is recessed at ground level, and appears to be gradually revealed as the ground in front of it is excavated to slope down.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The top of the wall remains level parallel with the ground and viewers descend passing along the wall, which becomes higher in relation to them the further along the wall they walk.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The memorial is extremely popular, due to its simple formal qualities and its gentle interactivity with the viewer.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The memorial invites participation and takes the viewer down below ground level to see the names symbolically buried but rising up to meet the light.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Its surface reflects the viewers, so that a multitude of faces appear on its surface.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The traditional methods of casting and carving continued to be popular, but many sculptors now began to use welded steel.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Ellsworth Kelly

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: An American sculptor who is best known for his 1960s to 80s work that consists of wall mounted steel shapes, distorted rhomboids, parallelograms and triangles.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are immaculately spray painted in matt primary colours and black and white, and butted up together one colour and shape against another, to create abstract works that are both sculpture and painting and have a contemplative lyrical presence.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Michael Kenny

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: British artist Kenny made wood and metal abstract sculpture.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: David Smith

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: British artist working from the 1960s onwards who made large welded steel sculptures.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Philip King

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: King is a British artist who made large steel sculptures between the 1960s and 80s.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: King made a number of public commissions, many of which can still be seen, for example in Fulham in London there is a red painted tubular steel structure work.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: King also made the designs for the decoration of the walls of Embankment underground station in London.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Hubert Dalwood

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: A British sculptor born in early 1930s who died in the 1970s, Dalwood made carved, cast and constructed sculptures from stone, bronze, acrylic resin, acrylic sheet and metal.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He also made a few paintings.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His early works were totemic stone objects and tabletop sculptures that were a bit like small abstract sculpture gardens, cast in aluminium or bronze.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He used tubular or square forms and wavy lines placed on a rectangular base that were cast in one piece and also made sculptures from acrylic with metal wire threaded through.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: As he became successful Dalwood began to be commissioned and he made a number of public works.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One example is a construction in a park made from brushed steel tubes of a large diameter fixed vertically to the ground in a cluster, reaching about 5 metres in height, curving around at the top like giant geometric plant stalks.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Another is an egg shaped bronze sculpture about one and a half metres in length lying on its side with some detail on its surface.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Alexander Calder

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: British sculptor working in the 1940s to 60s who became best known for his kinetic sculpture and mobiles, Calder is one of the very few artists to have used the mobile successfully as a form in sculpture.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Calder’s sculptures generally use circles, spheres and triangular shapes and rods.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are made in sheet metal, painted typically in black and white with red, yellow and blue.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Antony Caro

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro is a British artist who became very well known in the 1960s for his welded steel sculptures.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro was the most successful of a group of British artists who made large scale abstract steel sculptures in the 1960s and early 1970s.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: His were either cut from steel plate, or made of round and square cross section steel tubes, rods and I beams which were sometimes left to rust, but sometimes spray painted in primary colours.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro was one of the first sculptors to make semi abstract works on such a large scale.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro was influenced by the scale of ambition of his American contemporaries but his subject matter was initially the English landscape; his sculptures depict landscapes, although they appear abstract.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro used steel to make very open structures, often rather long and low, about 12 metres long and 2 metres high describing a kind of vista in space.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: One might be painted bright green, another bright yellow.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Smaller works might be made from shapes cut from sheet steel put together in which the ragged edge from the cutting tool is often left unfinished.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: In the 1990s Caro made a number of small steel sculptures of a chair based on the chair in Van Gogh's painting of his own bedroom.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Caro had been synonymous with a style of sculpture that was predominant in Britain for a decade, not least due to his years of teaching at St Martins School of Art in London, then a leading sculpture school.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Lynn Chadwick

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Chadwick's figurative bronzes range from life size to very small, around 30 cm high, human figures.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: They are angular, with stick like legs, flattened irregular trapezoid bodies, and heads that are either pyramid or cube shaped to denote female and male figures.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Chadwick was interested in the difference between male and female forms in terms of body language.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The bronzes mostly have a blue green coppery patina.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: John Chamberlain

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Working in the 1960s American artist Chamberlain made sculptures from compressed dumped cars that he either retrieved from the compressing press or took to be compressed.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: The resulting cubes were exhibited as sculpture.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: He sometimes extracted compressed parts of cars that he combined to make into sculptures.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.2; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.392

g.text:soa: Eduardo Chillida

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Mexican artist Chillida is a sculptor who made monumental steel sculptures which were usually site specific, often situated in natural environments.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: For example, one of his characteristic M or comb like structures is placed on a cliff top to rust and acquire its orange red colour.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: During the 1980s, artists began to have a far greater variety of media at their disposal.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Home video made it possible for anyone to shoot and edit films and large colour photographic prints were affordable.

text:soa.style: font-family: pm; font-size:1.1; text-rendering: optimizeLegibility; text-align: justify;line-interval:1.276

g.text:soa: Digital technology was in its infancy but desk top publishing, graphics programmes and digital printing began to make an impact on artist's practise.
